query:
SELECT 
  TABLE_NAME,
  COLUMN_NAME,
  COLUMN_TYPE,
  COLUMN_DEFAULT
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
  AND (
    COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%status%'
    OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%payment%'
    OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%state%'
  )
  AND TABLE_NAME NOT IN ('allowed_clients','asaas_payments','backup_history','bookings','bpo_charges','due_date_change_requests','expense_records','financial_charges','fuel_records','inspection_charges','inspections')
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME;
